rules.sql: SELECT 'premium_fy_table (trade_id, financial_year)' AS object, count(*) AS key_rows, sum(c) AS total_rows, max(c) AS max_per_key FROM (SELECT trade_id, financial_year, count(*) AS c FROM opera.premium_fy_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu GROUP BY trade_id, financial_year) t UNION ALL SELECT 'rms_premium_paid_table (trade_id)', count(*), sum(c), max(c) FROM (SELECT trade_id, count(*) AS c FROM opera.rms_premium_paid_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu GROUP BY trade_id) t UNION ALL SELECT 'latest_active_lot (trade_id)', count(*), sum(c), max(c) FROM (SELECT trade_id, count(*) AS c FROM opera.latest_active_lot WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu GROUP BY trade_id) t UNION ALL SELECT 'cloned_security_info_table (security_id)', count(*), sum(c), max(c) FROM (SELECT security_id, count(*) AS c FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu GROUP BY security_id) t UNION ALL SELECT 'valuation_date_table (business_unit)', count(*), sum(c), max(c) FROM (SELECT business_unit, count(*) AS c FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu GROUP BY business_unit) t UNION ALL SELECT 'valuation_financial_year_view (business_unit)', count(*), sum(c), max(c) FROM (SELECT business_unit, count(*) AS c FROM opera.valuation_financial_year_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu GROUP BY business_unit) t

SELECT 'helper_calculated_settle_price_view (security_id)' AS object, count(*) AS key_rows, sum(c) AS total_rows, max(c) AS max_per_key FROM (SELECT security_id, count(*) AS c FROM opera.helper_calculated_settle_price_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu GROUP BY security_id) t

SELECT 'helper_acc_group_type_view (security_id)' AS object, count(*) AS key_rows, sum(c) AS total_rows, max(c) AS max_per_key FROM (SELECT security_id, count(*) AS c FROM opera.helper_acc_group_type_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu GROUP BY security_id) t

SELECT 'helper_barrier_monitoring_view (security_id)' AS object, count(*) AS key_rows, sum(c) AS total_rows, max(c) AS max_per_key FROM (SELECT security_id, count(*) AS c FROM opera.helper_barrier_monitoring_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu GROUP BY security_id) t

SELECT 'fx_nc_factor_view (trade_id)' AS object, count(*) AS key_rows, sum(c) AS total_rows, max(c) AS max_per_key FROM (SELECT trade_id, count(*) AS c FROM opera.fx_nc_factor_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu GROUP BY trade_id) t

WITH ds AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, trade_id, security_id FROM opera.helper_deal_ticket_table_deal_status_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu ), s1 AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT ds.trade_id, ds.security_id, ds.business_unit, ds.tenant_id, vf.financial_year FROM ds JOIN opera.valuation_financial_year_view vf ON vf.tenant_id = ds.tenant_id AND vf.business_unit = ds.business_unit ), s2 AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT s1.trade_id, s1.security_id, s1.business_unit, s1.tenant_id FROM s1 JOIN opera.premium_fy_table pf ON pf.tenant_id = s1.tenant_id AND pf.business_unit = s1.business_unit AND pf.trade_id = s1.trade_id AND pf.financial_year = s1.financial_year ), s3 AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT s2.trade_id, s2.security_id, s2.business_unit, s2.tenant_id FROM s2 LEFT JOIN opera.helper_acc_group_type_view ag ON ag.tenant_id = s2.tenant_id AND ag.business_unit = s2.business_unit AND ag.security_id = s2.security_id ), s4 AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT s3.trade_id, s3.security_id, s3.business_unit, s3.tenant_id FROM s3 LEFT JOIN opera.helper_calculated_settle_price_view cs ON cs.tenant_id = s3.tenant_id AND cs.business_unit = s3.business_unit AND cs.security_id = s3.security_id ), s5 AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT s4.trade_id, s4.security_id, s4.business_unit, s4.tenant_id FROM s4 LEFT JOIN opera.rms_premium_paid_table rp ON rp.tenant_id = s4.tenant_id AND rp.business_unit = s4.business_unit AND rp.trade_id = s4.trade_id ), s6 AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT s5.trade_id, s5.security_id, s5.business_unit, s5.tenant_id FROM s5 LEFT JOIN opera.helper_settle_pricing_and_traders_pricing_view sp ON sp.tenant_id = s5.tenant_id AND sp.business_unit = s5.business_unit AND sp.security_id = s5.security_id ), s7 AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT s6.trade_id FROM s6 LEFT JOIN opera.fx_nc_factor_view fx ON fx.tenant_id = s6.tenant_id AND fx.business_unit = s6.business_unit AND fx.trade_id = s6.trade_id ) SELECT 1 AS stage, 'ds: helper_deal_ticket_table_deal_status_view' AS step, count(*) AS total_rows, count(DISTINCT trade_id) AS distinct_trades FROM ds UNION ALL SELECT 2, '+ valuation_financial_year_view', count(*), count(DISTINCT trade_id) FROM s1 UNION ALL SELECT 3, '+ premium_fy_table (inner)', count(*), count(DISTINCT trade_id) FROM s2 UNION ALL SELECT 4, '+ helper_acc_group_type_view (left)', count(*), count(DISTINCT trade_id) FROM s3 UNION ALL SELECT 5, '+ helper_calculated_settle_price_view (left)', count(*), count(DISTINCT trade_id) FROM s4 UNION ALL SELECT 6, '+ rms_premium_paid_table (left)', count(*), count(DISTINCT trade_id) FROM s5 UNION ALL SELECT 7, '+ helper_settle_pricing_and_traders_pricing_view (left)', count(*), count(DISTINCT trade_id) FROM s6 UNION ALL SELECT 8, '+ fx_nc_factor_view (left)', count(*), count(DISTINCT trade_id) FROM s7 ORDER BY 1

SELECT security_id, c AS rows_for_key, to_jsonb(v)::text AS row_json FROM ( SELECT security_id, count(*) AS c FROM opera.helper_calculated_settle_price_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu GROUP BY security_id HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 5 ) w JOIN opera.helper_calculated_settle_price_view v USING (security_id) WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = :bu ORDER BY c DESC, security_id LIMIT 50

SELECT security_id, c AS rows_for_key, to_jsonb(v)::text AS row_json FROM ( SELECT security_id, count(*) AS c FROM opera.helper_settle_pricing_and_traders_pricing_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = :bu GROUP BY security_id HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 5 ) w JOIN opera.helper_settle_pricing_and_traders_pricing_view v USING (security_id) WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = :bu ORDER BY c DESC, security_id LIMIT 50
